subject.title: fix(plugins): keep run context available after registration

question: Should the plugin API contract define run-context set, get, and clear as late-callable runtime operations while denying all access from an inactive registry?
rationale: This is a compatibility-sensitive behavioral boundary for external plugins; source and tests support the proposal, but automation cannot decide whether the stale-registry read restriction is the intended permanent contract.

options.title: Confirm contract after live proof
options.body: Require an installed-plugin runtime transcript, then approve the late-callable methods and inactive-registry read guard as the supported lifecycle contract.

options.title: Keep registration-closed behavior
options.body: Reject or redesign the patch and align the public run-context contract with registration-only availability instead.

recommendation.title: Confirm contract after live proof
recommendation.body: Require an installed-plugin runtime transcript, then approve the late-callable methods and inactive-registry read guard as the supported lifecycle contract.
